name: Mothership

scam_info.sample: We are not offering any discounts on watches. This particular scam implies we have S$139 deals on Rolexes. We do not.
scam_info.notes: Mothership self-impersonation warning (fake Mothership Facebook account selling discounted watches). Narrative; fake account names not listed.

scam_info.sample: More fraudulent Facebook accounts impersonating Mothership have been appearing on the feeds of social media users.
scam_info.notes: Series of self-impersonation warnings; others found via search (not opened): /2025/06/fb-impersonate-mothership/, /2026/04/watch-fake-omega-tissot-mothership/, /2026/01/mothership-penny-stocks-fake/ (fake penny-stock page), /2026/06/steven-chia-cna-article-scam/ (fake CNA-style article). No tag/RSS discovery endpoint found (homepage exposes only /category/* links; /tag/scam/ 404).

notes: official_domains: mothership.sg (b). robots.txt minimal (disallows /*/fb/*, /*/amp/*). Fake accounts are Facebook pages with pixelated Mothership-like logos; no concrete handles/URLs published. Social links taken from article footer (Facebook/Twitter links there are share buttons, not profiles).
